rationale: When step 7 of 10 encounters an unverified dependency crash or hostile payload fault during detonation, resuming risks operating on corrupted filesystem state while starting fresh discards expensive environment setup and package pre-compilation (wasting 45+ seconds of compute). A rollback policy leverages Celesto microVM snapshots taken at step 6: it instantly restores pristine memory and disk state in under 420ms, allowing deterministic retry or safe quarantine analysis without host exposure or compute waste.
